inline_prompts: You are given an N \times N grid S and an M \times M grid T. The cell at the i-th row from the top and the j-th column from the left is denoted by (i,j). The colors of the cells in S and T are represented by N^2 characters S_{i,j} (1\leq i,j\leq N) and M^2 characters T_{i,j} (1\leq i,j\leq M), respectively. In grid S, cell (i,j) is white if S_{i,j} is ., and black if S_{i,j} is #. The same applies for grid T. Find T within S. Note that the grid T must be found as a contiguous subgrid within S. Input The input is given from Standard Input in the following format: N M S_{1,1}S_{1,2}\dots S_{1,N} S_{2,1}S_{2,2}\dots S_{2,N} \vdots S_{N,1}S_{N,2}\dots S_{N,N} T_{1,1}T_{1,2}\dots T_{1,M} T_{2,1}T_{2,2}\dots T_{2,M} \vdots T_{M,1}T_{M,2}\dots T_{M,M} Output Print a and b. Constraints - 1 \leq M \leq N \leq 50 - N and M are integers. - Each of S_{i,j} and T_{i,j} is . or #. - There is exactly one pair (a,b) satisfying the condition.
